name: VNO evidence scoring rubric
purpose: Prevent agents from raising VNO percentages by opinion, wording or changing the formula. Scores must be earned by evidence milestones.

rules.bootstrapNote: RUN_072 and RUN_059 VNO files are initial conservative audits created before this rubric. Their scores remain explicitly provisional until converted to milestone evidence records; they cannot be used to claim D4+ or 100% readiness.

reproducibility.requirement: immutable source provenance + preserved raw result
documented deterministic reproduction command or harness
fixed preregistered criteria and preserved negative result policy
at least 30 previously unseen confirmation cases/seeds
at least 100 previously unseen confirmation cases/seeds or justified equivalent power
multiple materially different system/world sizes and stress scales
cross-platform or independently provisioned environment replay
public one-command reproduction package independently replayed without private setup

independence.requirement: discovery/confirmation roles or frozen criteria prevent same-run self-retuning
hidden confirmation cases generated/held by a separate process or role
independent verifier does not reuse implementation decision logic
clean-room reimplementation from specification without source-logic copying
separate harness/codebase reproduces the main result
different agent/model/provider reproduces result from frozen inputs
independent implementations agree across a larger hidden suite
result transfers to at least one genuinely different applicable system with its own proof
external reviewer/replicator not controlled by the original implementation loop reproduces result
external/public replication package yields reproducible confirmation by independent parties

falsification.requirement: explicit refutation condition fixed before confirmation
negative control expected to fail for the claimed causal reason
relevant negative predecessor/counterevidence preserved and incorporated
ablation removes the proposed causal mechanism
automated counterexample search across hidden cases
independent Red Team Scientist attempts to disprove strongest claim
multiple materially different failure modes/damage classes tested without post-hoc threshold changes
